playoff.entries: 16th in the Eredivisie vs six Eerste Divisie clubs
playoff.note: Nacompetitie: two pools, the 16th joins at the semi-final stage; one Eredivisie place at stake.

playoff.entries: 3rd-8th (four period champions plus the two best-placed others)
playoff.note: Knockout with the Eredivisie 16th for one Eredivisie place. Reserve (Jong) teams are ineligible.

playoff.entries: 14th and 15th (of the first teams) vs the Derde Divisie period champions
playoff.note: The 16th goes down direct; 14th/15th play off for one further place.

boundaries.note: Eerste Divisie: champion and runner-up up direct, 3rd-8th into the nacompetitie. Eredivisie: 17th and 18th down direct, 16th into the nacompetitie. Three places, one contested; if the 16th survives, only two clubs change level. Jong teams cannot take the promotion place.

Closed by KNVB decision (June 2022): promotion and relegation between the Eerste and Tweede Divisie is suspended for first teams for 5-10 seasons. Only one exchange survives, between the lowest-ranked Jong team in the Eerste Divisie and the best reserve team in the Tweede Divisie.

The two Derde Divisie champions (A and B) are promoted mandatorily. The Tweede Divisie 16th goes down direct; the 14th and 15th join the Derde Divisie period champions in a play-off for one further place, so the real totals move between 2 and 3 each way.

conflicts.note: The Eerste Divisie has had no sporting relegation since 2022 (KNVB suspension for 5-10 seasons). A Tweede Divisie amateur champion is not promoted; 2025-26 champions Quick Boys stayed put.

conflicts.real: Derde Divisie A (one of two level-4 divisions)
conflicts.note: The id is opaque but the mapping is right. Level 4 is two parallel divisions, A and B, 18 clubs each; we carry only A.

notes: Netherlands runs an August-May season. Eredivisie 18 clubs / 34 rounds; Eerste Divisie 20 / 38; Tweede Divisie 18 / 34; Derde Divisie two divisions of 18 / 34. Eerste Divisie promotion play-offs are seeded by the four period titles (quarters of the season) plus the two best-placed clubs not already qualified, so the entrants are usually 3rd-8th but not always. Tweede Divisie relegation is counted on first teams only, with a separate reserve-team route to the Under-21 division. Below the Derde Divisie sits the Vierde Divisie, not modelled, so 510 is closed_down in our data.
